title: centaurea boissieri subsp. jaennensis
intro: Centaurea boissieri subsp. jaennensis, commonly known as a type of knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family that is native to Spain and other parts of the world. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea boissieri subsp. jaennensis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-allergic agent, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and allergies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
